How It Works

Three Easy Steps to Get Started

We keep the process transparent, supportive, and hassle-free for parents.

01

Share Student Details

Share your child’s current grade, school board (CBSE, ICSE, IGCSE, State), and any specific math topics they find challenging.

Takes under 1 minute
02

30-Min Assessment Session

A friendly online 1-on-1 session where we explore visual puzzles together. Zero marks pressure — just joyful problem solving.

Parents are welcomed to attend
03

Personalized Growth Roadmap

We share comprehensive feedback highlighting your child’s cognitive strengths and recommend the exact curriculum path for them.

Zero-Stress Preparation

What to Expect on Assessment Day

Our 30-minute discovery session is designed to be joyful, engaging, and completely pressure-free.

Join 5 Mins Early

Grab a notebook and a pen in a quiet spot. Parents are warmly welcomed to sit in.

No Test Prep Needed

No formulas to memorize. We look at visual riddles to see how your child naturally explores problems.

Qualitative Parent Report

We discuss cognitive strengths, curiosity triggers, and the recommended learning pathway.
